help.blackjack.goal:
Beat the dealer with a hand closer to 21. Go over 21 and you bust and lose at once.
2–10 count at face value, J·Q·K count 10, A counts 1 or 11.
An A and a 10-value card as your first two cards is a Blackjack.
help.blackjack.play:
Tap chips ({chips}) to build your bet, then press DEAL. Bets are {min}–{max} credits in steps of {unit}.
CLEAR removes the bet; REBET places last round's bet again.
HIT: take one more card.
STAND: keep your hand.
DOUBLE: double the bet and take exactly one more card. First two cards only.
SPLIT: split two cards of the same value into two hands and add the same bet again.
When every hand is done, the dealer reveals and the round is settled.
help.blackjack.rules:
A {decks}-deck shoe is used. Once {cut}% of the shoe is dealt, it is reshuffled before the next round.
The dealer draws on 16 or less and stands on all 17s (soft 17 included).
With an A or a 10-value card showing, the dealer checks for Blackjack first. A dealer Blackjack ends the round at once.
You can split once. Split aces get one card each.
21 on a split hand is not a Blackjack; it pays as a normal win (1:1).
Double after split is allowed.
No insurance, no surrender.
DOUBLE and SPLIT need enough credits to match the bet.
help.crash.auto:
Turn on AUTO CASH OUT and set a target ({min}×–{max}×). The 1.5×·2×·5× buttons are quick picks.
The moment the multiplier reaches the target you cash out automatically. You can still cash out by hand before that.
If the rocket crashes before reaching the target, the auto cash out does not happen.
help.crash.goal: While the rocket climbs, the multiplier rises from 1.00×. Cash out before it crashes and you get bet × the multiplier at that moment. If it crashes first, the bet is lost.
help.crash.play:
Set your bet in the BET box: {min}–{max} credits in steps of {step}. 100·1K·MAX are quick picks.
Press BET: the rocket launches after a {sec}-second countdown. You can CANCEL during the countdown.
At launch the bet is taken and the multiplier starts rising.
Press CASH OUT whenever you like to settle at that multiplier.
LAST shows where the rocket crashed in the last {hist} rounds.
help.crash.rules:
The payout is bet × multiplier, rounded down to a whole credit.
Cashing out at exactly the crash multiplier still wins.
The multiplier can go as high as {cap}×.
help.ocean.bonus:
When the reels go dark and a sea creature swims past, the BONUS lamp lights up.
On the rounds that follow, the bonus pays out in a chain, on top of any reel wins. The BONUS amount and the chain count are shown on screen.
The bigger the creature, the bigger the bonus total.
An unpaid bonus stays with you if you visit the lobby and come back.
If you CASH OUT or run low on credits with a bonus still unpaid, the rest is paid at once.
help.ocean.goal: A 5-reel, 3-row, 20-line arcade machine. Three or more matching symbols in a row from the leftmost reel win, and when a sea creature appears, bonus wins come pouring out in a chain.
help.ocean.play:
Each press of BET moves the bet to the next step: {steps}.
Press START or swipe down on the reels to spin.
While the reels turn, press STOP or tap the reels to stop them right away.
Turn on the TURBO switch for faster stops.
The CREDIT·BET·WIN windows show your balance, bet and win.
help.ocean.ticket: A win of 10× the bet or more prints ABYSS LEGEND prize tickets from the TICKET slot. Winnings always go straight to your credit balance.
help.ocean.wild: The treasure chest WILD appears on reels 2, 3 and 4 only and substitutes for every symbol, golden pearl included.
help.reels.payNote: Payouts are multiples of the line bet. Line bet = total bet ÷ 20.
help.reels.rules:
A win must run unbroken from the leftmost reel. 3, 4 or 5 of the same symbol pay as shown in the table.
Only the longest win on each line pays; wins on different lines are added together.
The total bet is spread evenly over all 20 lines.
help.reels.wild: WILD appears on reels 2, 3 and 4 only and substitutes for every symbol, 7 included.
help.roulette.goal: European roulette with 37 pockets, 0 to 36, and a single zero. Bets covering the pocket where the ball lands win.
help.roulette.play:
Pick a chip ({chips}) and tap a spot on the table to place it.
Tap the edge between two adjacent numbers for a split bet on both.
Press and hold a spot to take its chips back. UNDO removes the last chip, CLEAR removes them all.
REBET places last round's bets again.
Press SPIN: the chips on the table are your bet and the wheel spins. Turn on TURBO for a faster spin.
LAST 20 shows the last 20 results.
help.roulette.rules:
35:1 means you get your stake back plus 35 times the stake.
When 0 comes up, only straights and splits covering 0 win; outside bets (red·black, odd·even, 1–18·19–36, dozens, columns) all lose.
The table bet per round is {min} to {max} credits.
help.slot.goal: A 5-reel, 3-row, 20-line slot. Three or more matching symbols in a row from the leftmost reel win. Five 7s pay the top prize.
help.slot.play:
Choose the total bet with BET ({steps}).
Press SPIN or swipe down on the reels to spin.
While the reels turn, press STOP or tap the reels to stop them right away.
Turn on TURBO for faster stops.
AUTO spins a set number of times ({auto}). Press AUTO again to stop; it also stops when credits run low.
